heading: Free Game Analysis, Live on Stream
body:
Want me to do a full breakdown of one of your games? I’ll do it completely free, as long as I can stream the session live on Twitch and use parts of it for content afterwards.

We’ll go through your game together, break down your key decisions, and look at where you can improve – live, one-on-one, and in-depth. I’ll also turn some of the best parts of the session into YouTube content.
